overview: A beam-steering and translation module added to TDTR for controlled pump–probe separation. Multi-azimuth offset scans probe lateral heat spreading and distinguish in-plane anisotropy that is weakly constrained in concentric measurements.
overviewZh: 在 TDTR 上增加光束转向与位移控制，实现泵浦-探测光斑的可控分离。沿多个方位角进行偏置扫描，可表征横向热扩散并区分常规同轴测量难以约束的面内各向异性。
principle: Scanning the lateral pump–probe separation measures a spatial thermoreflectance profile. Its width and shape depend on lateral heat diffusion, beam sizes and modulation conditions. An anisotropic heat-flow model, using scans along selected directions, constrains in-plane conductivity; anisotropy does not inherently shift the profile peak.
principleZh: 扫描泵浦与探测光斑的横向间距，获得空间热反射响应；其宽度和形状取决于面内热扩散、光斑尺寸与调制条件。沿选定方向扫描，并结合各向异性传热模型，可约束面内热导率。各向异性本身并不必然使响应峰位移动。
